latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the KAYAK travel search platform skill.

- Provides an overview of KAYAK’s company background and key features.
- Details on core services: flight, hotel, car rental searches, and vacation packages.
- Explains unique features such as price prediction and flexible discovery.
- Includes money-saving tips and best booking time advice.
- Answers common questions about booking, platform role, and service accuracy.
